experiment: HH-CENSUS-1 source-native human-preference input feasibility, helpful-base TRAIN only
hypothesis: The published helpful-base TRAIN pair schema can expose a shared dialogue context and two distinct last-assistant response candidates without model-visible chosen/rejected labels. This is source preparation, not a semantic mechanism hypothesis.

source.labels: Publisher-reported human preference comparisons over model-generated assistant candidates, not factual truth or independent population probabilities. Annotator IDs and source-conversation IDs are not documented by the pair schema.

rights.declared_data_license: MIT in pinned owner dataset card
rights.research_acquisition_review: Pinned owner card explicitly releases preference data for reward-model research and declares MIT. This permits the bounded local research input census; do not train a generative dialogue agent, republish raw transcripts or infer permissions for private personal data.
rights.remaining_review: Source privacy, provenance and complete conversation grouping before any shipping training or final statistical claims. No shipping claim follows from this census.
rights.attribution: Anthropic; Bai et al. Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback, arXiv2204.05862. Retain card and copyright/license notices.

exclusions.test: No TEST files downloaded or opened; no final labels decoded. Published TEST is not universally fresh.
exclusions.other_tranches: No helpful-online or rejection-sampled data; no red-team transcripts.
exclusions.harmless_train: Metadata VirusTotal scan reports suspicious1/76 for bf3e1ecd... on harmless-base/train. Do not download or parse this artifact in this study. This is a publisher scan report, not our malware finding.

data.acquisition: Only README already acquired and exact helpful-base TRAIN gzip; no remote dataset scripts, credentials, authenticated requests or model artifacts. Assert byte count and SHA256 before decompressing.
data.reader: Direct gzip + strict JSON object parser, exact chosen/rejected string keys, no code execution. Bound each uncompressed JSON line to2MiB; any schema, hash or resource error retains partial output and fails the census, never drops rows.
data.allocation: None. No train/dev/final reshuffle or fitting/calibration pool is created in this input-only census. Future study must freeze full source-conversation/dedup grouping and splits before scoring.
data.row_identity: Preserve every source line ordinal and SHA256 of its original JSON bytes. Pair input fingerprint hashes a sorted array of full transcript SHA256s, invariant to exchanging chosen/rejected roles.
data.projection: Split each transcript at its last exact newline-newline Assistant marker. Projectable only if prefixes match byte-for-byte, prefix starts with newline-newline Human marker, both suffixes are nonblank and suffixes differ. No truncation or inferred repair. Retain every nonprojectable row in the source denominator with one deterministic reason.
data.group_proxy: For valid shared contexts hash NFKC+casefold+whitespace-normalized first Human turn before its first Assistant marker. This is an input-only conservative root-prompt proxy, NOT proof of original conversation independence; unavailable conversation and annotator identifiers remain a limitation.
data.persist: Metadata row ledger only: ordinal/native-line hash/input-pair hash, projectability/reason, exact shared-context/response hashes, character counts and normalized root-prompt proxy. No plaintext transcripts, preferred side, scores or targets in exported census or Git.

controls: Role-swapping chosen/rejected leaves all input-census fields unchanged except original-line hash
Distinct responses required; duplicate and blank responses retained as unprojectable
Separate shared-context mismatch from missing formatting; never repair with outcome information
Independent reconstruction from exact pinned source bytes without calling the census projection function
metrics: Projection reason counts and all-row denominator
Exact-context and root-prompt proxy unique counts and repeated-group sizes
Native pair duplicates and maximum characters, without token or context support claims
statistics: Deterministic source census only; no confidence interval, hypothesis-test outcome, quality gate or independent-example-count claim.

gates.custody: Committed protocol and implementation before TRAIN acquisition or parsing; exact pinned source bytes and no nonregistered artifact access.
gates.coverage: Every native TRAIN line persisted, including nonprojectable rows. No cap, cherry-picking or label-based filter.
gates.reconstruction: Independent exact ledger and manifest hashes must match; swapped-role and schema boundary regressions.
gates.capability: Always false; architecture, prompts, learned mechanisms, quality gates and training await a separate prospective study.

failure: Retain partial source/ledger and failure receipt. Fix implementation only prospectively with unchanged source bytes, row membership, source denominator and every original failure retained.
next_branch: If custody and source projection feasibility pass, a separately preregistered natural-variable-question human-preference Choice study may use this source after NATIVE-2 evidence and question-conditioned interface selection. Unprojectable rows and lineage uncertainty remain explicit. No arbitrary-criteria, many-axis, Score, OOD, calibration, shipping or Pareto credit.
